    int[] previousNodes, nextNodes; int nodeCounter = 1;
    int link(int from, int to) {

        queueCount = 0;
    }

        int h = totalEdges++;

        sourceEdges[u] = link(sourceEdges[u], h << 1);
        sourceEdges[v] = link(sourceEdges[v], (h << 1) | 1);
    }

    }

        if (i > queueCount) return 0;
        if (i < queueCount && compare(priorityQueue[i + 1], priorityQueue[i])) return i + 1;
        return i;

    void pq_up(int u) {
        int i, j, v;
        for (i = inQueue[u]; (j = i / 2) > 0 && compare(u, v = priorityQueue[j]); i = j)

        priorityQueue[inQueue[u] = i] = u;

        priorityQueue[inQueue[u] = ++queueCount] = u;
